caption: The drawing depicts a single, light-colored dress that appears to be made of a delicate, possibly semi-transparent fabric. The dress features short sleeves, a square neckline, and elaborate decorative details, including small floral patterns and rows of trim along the neckline, the edge of the sleeves, and the bodice. The bodice has horizontal pleats and intricate vertical lines, while the waistband is defined by a thin, horizontal band. The skirt is gathered at the waist and falls to about knee-length, where it is adorned with horizontal pleats and a wide hem of lace featuring floral and geometric patterns. The overall color palette consists of soft creams and light pinkish-beige tones, with fine lines and shading used to indicate the texture and embroidery. The background is plain and light, emphasizing the dress as the sole subject of the composition.
title: Child's Dress
